grants.description: Verify your identity as the business owner or property occupier
grants.purpose: To confirm you are authorized to register this property for business rates

grants.description: Share property details from Valuation Office Agency records
grants.purpose: To verify the property is liable for business rates and calculate the correct amount

grants.description: Share business information to assess eligibility for Small Business Rate Relief
grants.purpose: To determine if you qualify for relief schemes that reduce or eliminate your bill

grants.description: Authorize payment of business rates bill to local authority
grants.purpose: To process your business rates payment and set up instalment plan if requested

revocation.mechanism: Contact your local council or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Registration will be cancelled. You remain legally liable for business rates but must contact council to arrange alternative payment.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payment on your behalf. Agent cannot challenge your rateable value. Agent cannot confirm self-catering or home business criteria without your explicit declaration. Agent must handoff for disputes or complex property arrangements.
